# Resto by Arkadya: full reference
Updated 2026-10-15. Canonical site: https://restaurant.arkadya.tech/

## What it is
Resto builds websites for restaurants in Thailand. The goal is that guests find the restaurant on Google, read the menu and book a table directly, without a delivery platform in between. Resto is a product of Arkadya (Thai Online Solutions Co., Ltd., Khanom, Nakhon Si Thammarat).

## Price
3,900 THB, paid once. The site also shows a regular price of 6,000 THB.

## What the package lists
- Custom restaurant website
- English, French and Thai versions
- Table booking with WhatsApp confirmation
- Digital menu (photos or written items)
- Google Maps and local SEO basics (structured data, meta tags)
- Mobile-first responsive design
- 0% commission on direct bookings

Features or integrations beyond this list are not part of the 3,900 THB package; ask for a quote.

## How it works
1. You send the menu, opening hours, address and a few photos.
2. We build and launch the site. A standard site can be live in as little as 2 days once the material is complete; extra features or integrations can take longer.
3. Later changes (prices, a new dish, opening hours) are requested through WhatsApp.

## Who it is for
Restaurants, cafes and eateries in Thailand that want their own website alongside delivery apps and social media, in English, French and Thai.
